name: Beijing
tagline: 1864 Peking duck, reinvented with a Michelin star at the table next door.

Quanjude.description: China's most famous lacquered duck, roasted in a jujube-wood oven since 1864.

Dadong.description: A modern reinvention of Peking duck, with crispy skin and fine-dining presentation. Michelin star.

Bianyifang.description: Beijing's oldest Peking duck restaurant, dating to 1416, using the closed-oven "menlu" method.

Najia Xiaoguan.description: Imperial Manchu cuisine from the Na family, descendants of Qing nobility, with recipes dating to 1748.

Wangfujing Snack Street.description: A covered street with more than 500 kinds of Chinese street food, under a traditional 10-meter arch.
